items.q: How does he score an assistant?
items.a: [[thin-prompt-as-the-test]]. One shot, almost no instructions. Follow-ups would score him.

items.q: Why did Hermes draw the brand brain?
items.a: [[same-model-memory-wins]]. Same [[gpt-6-astra]] as Dot. Memory had the blueprints. Dot animated a generic still. The bad podcast cut is the prompt.

items.q: What does each one cost to start?
items.a: [[hands-off-cloud-vs-own-metal]]. Dot: ChatGPT Pro, he says $100 then $100/$200/$500, one Dot. Grokbot: $20. Hermes: $0 software, you pay models or hardware and time.

items.q: Which ones work with the laptop shut?
items.a: Dot and Grokbot. Hermes only if a VPS or a Mac Mini stays on. It can also run offline.

items.q: What does he tell a beginner?
items.a: Grokbot or Dot. Tight budget: Grokbot. Already living in ChatGPT: Dot. He thinks Dot is a couple of weeks behind and will catch up.
[[builder-desk-vs-pocket-assistant]]. Desk builds the software. The assistant is ideas, messages, the morning weight ping.
